lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I called you urgently because there's something to discuss. Sorry, could you wait a moment? There's something I need to do first.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Of course.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What is it?)

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: Did you call, Lady Io?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I tried to overlook it, but I can't. As Gerda's representative, there is one thing I must do.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: So I would like your permission, Feta.

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: What? What do you...? I don't mind. Do as you wish, Lady Io.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Then I'll take that as your consent.
(Io raises her hand and slaps Feta.)

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: ...Lady Io?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Feta, apologize to %s. And apologize to me and everyone in Gerda.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: You knew about the witch. And you must have realized that someone like me knew about witches too.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Even if your arrival in Gerda was no coincidence, you should at least have told us.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: More than your own life, all of us could have been endangered... Why did you say nothing? Feta, you aren't such a foolish mage.

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: I didn't think it through. I only wanted to meet the adventurer and deliver it, so I was waiting for the right moment...

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: But you both kept leaving so quickly that I never had a chance to speak.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Did we? A poor excuse for a gifted mage, but I'll believe you.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Perhaps you lacked faith. At least, faith that we would help you... So you simply watched and waited.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Leave Gerda within a few days. No, more precisely, return to Freios.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: A dangerous day will soon come to Eastland. Your mana could become a sacrifice to the binding that man desires.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Weiss...

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: Lady Io, I'm sorry. I made a mistake.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I can see you're sincere, so I forgive you. Thanks to you, we were able to judge the timing somewhat.

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: That is...

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: This isn't a matter for you to involve yourself in. Step back now. Farewell.
(Feta looks at Io, who seems unwilling to speak further. After a moment, he nods in understanding and leaves.)

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Sorry. Have you been waiting long?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I don't enjoy doing that, but sometimes it's necessary. And Feta will need watching.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: You don't have to do it yourself. One of Dayna's subordinates, I think? They seem capable enough...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You know Dayna?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Roughly. Enough of that. I'll get to the point. Before long, Weiss will summon Deimos.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Before that, I mean to open a sealed path in the Debora Snowfields. Breaking the seal will be no easy task.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: We need to keep binding from spreading into the snowfields and create a space to use as a temporary base.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Only then can we go to Avalon.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There's something I need to do in the meantime.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Binding is transformed life force. Even if it isn't the same kind of power, we'll need enough mana to withstand it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How much?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: The only major group of mages in Eastland is the Jewel School. Only a few remain in Lumen. Even with all their strength, I don't know how long they could hold...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If I receive the trace of Lady Medea's power, couldn't we manage somehow?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I don't know how much power Medea has... But I think it will still fall short. Lady Iris is worried too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, you spoke with Iris?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Have you forgotten? I've been receiving messages from the goddess longer than you have, %s.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Our conversation has frozen solid. Let's break through and move on.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: The Silvaria Empire stands on land that witnessed the twilight of the gods. There should be a way to delay a god's arrival there.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: They may already know about it. Their empress has the gift of foresight, doesn't she...?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: The Alliance of Light has explained the situation and sent a letter to the Silvaria Empire. They'll have ample reason to help.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: %s, I want you to go and find a way. See Medea first. She may point you in the right direction.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. I'll go.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I'll be waiting...
(Io watches %s leave Gerda almost as soon as the adventurer arrived.)

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Even for %s, the goddess's messenger, this won't be easy...

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: But what was an Agasura doing there? I'm sure someone else was there too...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I've been waiting.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I don't know what to say. Why do you...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Please go ahead, Lady Medea.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I will tell you where I stand when you return. And...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: For this matter, you will have to go there, whether you like it or not.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There...?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Knossos...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: A 'power' resides there. I cannot tell whether it belongs to a god, a witch, or an Agasura...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: But I believe what you obtain there could make things difficult for Weiss...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't know what sort of place it is, but I'll go.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: You are...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Stronger than anyone.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I pray that nothing happens to you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lady Medea? Why are you speaking as though we'll never meet again?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Am I? This is simply how I speak...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Heh...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Whether you like it or not, you will have to keep coming to see me...
(Medea smiles faintly.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. I'll visit often.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Whew. The barrier around our village doesn't work on you anyway...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Go straight to Sir Ziskad. He will tell you where to go.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will. But will he be in Lumen? He's often away...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I believe he went to see his sister.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: And...
(Medea gently taps %s on the shoulder with her staff.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (She's tapping my shoulder like she did before...)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: You must come back...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will. Don't worry too much. Everything will be fine. I'll be back!

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Until next time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (By the lakeshore... I wonder how Jenna is doing.)

steps.name: Finding the Way (3)
steps.objective: Follow [Iris], then turn in the quest to [Soleil] in 「Magic Academy Lobby」.

lines.text: (A lovely melody drifts from a quiet stretch of lakeshore in Zisk Territory.)
(Clearer and sweeter than before, the steady voice flows across the calm surface of the lake.)

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: I'll smile a little at a time. ♬ If I keep smiling, the smile will become my own.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Even so, I can't help feeling awkward. ♬

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: I can't see my reflection in the pond... But that isn't everything. ♪
(Startled by sudden applause, Jenna turns around.)

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: %s, you're here? I heard clapping so suddenly, I thought a ghost had come.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: What's the matter?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, your song was so lovely that I couldn't help myself... Did I startle you?

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: A little, but it's all right. What brings you here? Did you come to see my brother?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. I heard Sir Ziskad would be here.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Oh, dear. He was waiting, but something came up and he hurried back just now. I'll give you his message instead.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, really? Then please tell me.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Ahem. One, two, three... 'Ah, you've come.'

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Jenna, is that an impression of Sir Ziskad...?

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Does it sound awkward? I did practice... Maybe I shouldn't. Please keep listening.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: My brother said you might already know this person and should go see her. An elven mage famous in the Silvaria Empire...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh? Soleil?

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: He said we need to strengthen our relationship with the Silvaria Empire. The empress has been quite friendly toward us...

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: And apparently there are some unexpected connections between them...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Connections...)

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: What is that elven mage like?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Unusual and fun. She likes delicious desserts too.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: I'd love to meet her if I have the chance.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm sure you will someday.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Do you think so? It's all thanks to Lady Gaia's grace... I'm always grateful.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Jenna looks happier than she used to...)

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: I wish I could help you and my brother too, %s...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's all right. Just being here already gives Sir Ziskad so much strength.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Thank you, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Then let's return to Freios...)
(Just as %s is about to leave Zisk Territory, someone takes the adventurer's hand.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh?
%s... Wait a moment.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: ...Lady Iris?
(At the mention of Iris, the adventurer turns to see her smiling brightly, as she appeared in the Chamber of Revelation.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Iris?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Jenna, it's been a while. I'm sorry to appear so suddenly. May I borrow the adventurer?

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Of course. We finished talking.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Then, %s...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll come. You have something to tell me, right? Where are we going?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Keep holding my hand and close your eyes.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: O-okay.
(As Iris finishes speaking, a mysterious light flows from her fingertips and envelops them both.)

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: She left the lakeshore a gift of beautiful light.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: I should finish singing. Something to sing for Ell when she comes...

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Why have the Algae stopped moving? They were moving perfectly well a moment ago...

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Oh... So that's why my brother left in such a hurry...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Open your eyes.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, this is...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Cough, cough...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris? Are you all right?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I'm fine. If we hadn't come here immediately, it would have been dangerous.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What do you mean?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Zisk Territory is slowly being consumed.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Could Weiss be...?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: My power doesn't reach that far, so I can't know for certain. But an ominous power is flowing out of Avalon.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: There had been no signs from Avalon until now... But the power filling it has overflowed into Zisk Territory.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Sir Ziskad hurried to stop it and asked me to take care of you.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Lady Io and Lady Medea are sorry. They didn't know this would happen.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm fine, but you put yourself in danger.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: It's all right. I can endure that much. I have to.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Will Jenna be all right?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Jenna is safe. That power only affects living beings.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If that's the case...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, there's no time to stand around. I have to hurry.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I'll keep focusing on preventing the ominous power flowing from Avalon from spreading elsewhere.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I say this all the time, but thank you. And I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Me too...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: You're going to meet Lady Soleil, right? I'll send you there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, Iris. Do you know anything about the witch who sent me a message?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Since ascending to divinity, I've only learned of this world's recent events. So I don't have much information about witches.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: The witches have been in this world longer than anyone realizes. They seem to be waiting for what comes after the matter of Deimos.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Waiting? Deimos appearing wouldn't be good for them...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I'll tell you as soon as I learn more.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll look into it too. Right now, stopping Deimos matters more than the witches.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll be going, then.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Yes. Give me your hand and close your eyes.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: As I said before, as long as my power can reach you and I have this heart, I'll act for you. And I'll be here for everyone who has cherished me.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: So don't push yourself too hard. All right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right, Iris.
(As soon as %s finishes speaking, Iris takes the adventurer's hand.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Her hand is warm...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (That warmth feels like Iris's faith in me...)

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: Are you awake, %s?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh, my head hurts...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where am I?

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: Do you recognize me?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Soleil?

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: Yes, yes! It's me!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I made it to the right place.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, I'm dizzy...

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: Lie here for a moment. I'll bring the healing magic teacher.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: ...Are you all right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. I feel much better now, thanks to you.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: What a relief. The impact must have been worse than I thought.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Impact?

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: I was on my way back from Glaston. Something fell out of the sky with a thud, and we had a traffic accident.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A traffic accident...?

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: Feybris grabbed it in his jaws and shook it. It looked like a person, so I told him to spit it out.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: When I looked, it was you, Adventurer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I fell out of the sky? And collided with you riding that monster?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It tried to eat me?

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: It's hard to believe, but it's true.
(Behind Soleil, a three-headed monster, neither clearly wolf nor dog, growls and barks.)

lines.speaker: 페이브리스
lines.text: Roooowf!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You startled me! That's a Cerberus!

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: No, it's Feybris. I fed him and took him for a walk, so I don't know what he's unhappy about...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Here, take this. It's pet jerky from Lumen.

lines.speaker: 페이브리스
lines.text: Rooooowf!
(Feybris eagerly runs over and takes the jerky. As he eats, he occasionally gives Soleil a chilly look.)

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: ...I've never seen him make that face. Suddenly, I'm remembering when I turned into something like him. How embarrassing.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You were quite fierce then, Soleil.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: Ahaha...

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: Now, Feybris, get home safely. Ljosalf or Dokkalf, whichever you like.

lines.speaker: 페이브리스
lines.text: Ruff, ruff!
(Feybris nods and soars into the sky. He races into a white cloud and disappears.)

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: Then, Adventurer, I can help you... Huh, what's this wind?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris...
(A familiar voice rides an unexpected breeze toward %s.)

lines.speaker: 이리스의 목소리
lines.text: (%s, I'm sorry. I said I'd take you to Lady Soleil, but... I didn't know she'd be in the sky riding Feybris.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's all right, Iris. These things happen. It's your first time, so you're still getting used to it. It's fine...

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: Lady Iris must be here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, she didn't come in person. She sent me a message.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: I see...

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: Then I'll tell you what I've prepared for you.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: Even before Sir Ziskad sent his request, Her Majesty told me to gather information about Deimos.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...How could Her Majesty prepare before the Champions did?

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: ...I can't tell you anything about that. I don't really know...

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: Anyway, with the librarians at Belpha Library, I learned of an object that could delay Deimos's arrival.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: After the age of twilight, when the gods tried to leave this world, some beings who wished to remain tried to stop them.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: They found what they needed: the remains of dead gods whose forms partly survived, rather than gods who had been completely annihilated.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: They made an object to hold back those who were leaving. But the gods' anger remained within it.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: The power of the nameless gods, absorbing that anger, began to beat like a heart. Then it rushed toward the Demon King.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The Beast...)

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: The Demon King was unaffected. Instead, it turned the power back upon the gods who had tried to kill it.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: The power meant to hold back the departing gods struck those who remained, devoured their lifespans, and fell somewhere.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: So we believe that the divine lifespan it absorbed, that power, could slightly delay the moment of Deimos's descent.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where could such an object be?

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: We believe it's in Knossos, in the Beastman Empire of Creed. Beyond the western El Anoir Plains.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Knossos...)

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: The beastmen believe a sacred object is there. They say it exploded during the Sky of Chaos and drove their enemies away...

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: I don't know whether that's true, but it's worth investigating.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Soleil. I'll go there. Somehow, I feel the answer we need is waiting...

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: There should be imperial rangers there. Her Majesty authorized your entry, so just speak with them. And I really haven't done much...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, you've helped.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: Then after you leave, I'll work with the mages of Freios to find ways to help.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: See you later, Soleil.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: Yes, Adventurer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Let's go to Knossos... The answer must be there.)
(Beyond the old trees of the western El Anoir Plains, an eerie wind blows along the path.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I only went a little deeper beyond the El Anoir Plains, but the atmosphere is completely different.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I have a bad feeling. That is...
(At the end of a neglected path stand a guard post and barricade bearing the markings of the Silvaria Empire.)
(A figure in ranger's clothing spots %s approaching from afar and takes a defensive stance.)

lines.speaker: 유격병
lines.text: Halt! Move, and I will attack under imperial law. Show something proving your identity.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Will this do?
(Still wary, the ranger approaches and snatches the paper envelope from %s's hand.)

lines.speaker: 유격병
lines.text: Let me check. This is what the imperial family uses for correspondence... The imperial crest... Even Her Majesty's name matches. Then you are...

lines.speaker: 유격병
lines.text: Please forgive my rudeness.
(The ranger's manner instantly softens.)

lines.speaker: 하바티
lines.text: Greetings. I am Corporal Havarti of the Silvaria Empire's ranger corps. I've heard of your accomplishments, but never imagined I'd meet you in person.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm really not that impressive.

lines.speaker: 하바티
lines.text: And humble too... You truly are an example to everyone. Forgive me for saying this, but I'm a fan!

lines.speaker: 하바티
lines.text: I'm a little nervous... Ahaha, I've heard so much about yooou...
(The ranger's voice trembles slightly.)

lines.speaker: 하바티
lines.text: What brings you to Knossos? If someone as important as you has come, it must be a serious matter...

lines.speaker: 하바티
lines.text: Actually, my assignment instructions included a clause to help %s enter Knossos if you arrived.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: 하바티
lines.text: Yes. I will help with all my heart. But...

lines.speaker: 하바티
lines.text: It's been several months since I was stationed here, and nothing unusual has happened in Knossos.

lines.speaker: 하바티
lines.text: Animals and beastmen wander around, and occasionally you see fairies that aren't found elsewhere.

lines.speaker: 하바티
lines.text: If anything, the previous post commander went to ask Talos something before I arrived and disappeared.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Disappeared?

lines.speaker: 하바티
lines.text: Yes. Though Talos said he never saw the commander.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But who is Talos?

lines.speaker: 하바티
lines.text: The sole caretaker of Knossos. I don't know how the beastmen manage it, but apparently his family has tended the place for generations.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...I'd like to meet him. Where is he?

lines.speaker: 하바티
lines.text: If you go deeper into Knossos, you'll find him strolling around at his leisure.

lines.speaker: 하바티
lines.text: Fortunately, he's friendlier toward imperial citizens and outsiders than most beastmen.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Havarti.

lines.speaker: 하바티
lines.text: Not at all, Adventurer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is there anything I could help with on the way to Talos?

lines.speaker: 하바티
lines.text: Such thoughtfulness too... Hmm, what could I ask? Aha!

lines.speaker: 하바티
lines.text: Please have a pleasant visit! That alone will satisfy me. I love you, Adventurer!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (That's a bit much to hear with a straight face...)

lines.speaker: 하바티
lines.text: Adventurer?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahaha. Nothing.

lines.speaker: 하바티
lines.text: I'd like to guide you myself, but I'm on duty. I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahaha... Then I'll have a pleasant visit. See you later, Havarti.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (But this place... The atmosphere changed as I was about to enter. It's stirring.)

steps.name: Keeper of Knossos (1)
steps.objective: Defeat [Hungry Lioncat] and [Life Homun] in 「Knossos」. Then report to [Talos].

lines.text: (Strange structures, waterfalls, and forest intertwine in an uncanny landscape. An untended path stretches endlessly between them.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That stirring feeling seems to have faded. Was it my imagination? Hmm...
(After walking some distance, the adventurer sees someone standing ahead.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is that the person Ranger Havarti mentioned?
(A man with long hair whiter than snow looks this way. Despite his calm expression, his ears are tense and alert.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I'm not sure, but he feels like a predator watching its prey... Animal ears, but no tail. He doesn't seem to be a beastman... And he feels different from the Kali people...)
What? Interested in me?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. What? Yes?
I'm Talos, caretaker of Knossos. Good to meet you.
(The man who introduced himself as Talos extends a hand.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (His hand is bigger than I expected.)

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: What are you doing? You're leaving my hand embarrassed.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Right. I'm %s...

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: %s...? Nice name. Where have I heard it? Maybe because it isn't common? %s, %s... Just call me by my name. We're not in the same organization anyway...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right, Talos. There's something I'd like to ask...

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: %s? %s! I'd like to return your interest in a little while.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Return my interest?

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: For now, help me clean things up.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: You came here because you want something from me, right? Then focus on what I need right now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What do you...?

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Just do what you always do. There, that way.
(Talos immediately runs toward the place he indicated.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What is with this person? Do what I always do...?)

steps.name: Keeper of Knossos (2)
steps.objective: Defeat [Nakun Rogue] and [Aquila Fighter] in 「Knossos」. Then report to [Talos] in 「Knossos」.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Knossos isn't normally like this. It's as calm as still water.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Not many beastmen remain, and spirits and fairies usually move about quietly...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But now they're all acting aggressively?

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Are they trying to surprise me? Did I do something wrong?
(Talos strokes his chin with a serious expression.)

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: They're sensitive to outside power... Ah, I think I understand.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Some power you possess, or some power directed at you, is stirring this place.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Even the finest mages and warriors never disturbed it... How deeply are you involved with these things called gods?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait. That's a strange way to put it...

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: A god precious to one person may be meaningless to another.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: For me and most of the lives in Knossos, it's the latter. Gods whose existence makes no difference.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: When you need them most, gods sometimes fail to appear. And the ancient gods have a history of fleeing, too.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: That's how it is for me, at least. If I can't see or meet them anyway, surely I can resent them a little. Right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I suppose, but...

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: No time for this. Here they come. Knossos's residents don't like guests, so let's drive them off.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Talos...

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: If you have questions, ask afterward.

steps.name: A Necessary Item
steps.objective: Defeat [Pasiphae] in 「Memory of the Heart」 and obtain the <Heart of Wrath: Left Fragment>. Then report to [Talos] in 「Knossos」.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: We've driven off enough that it should be quiet for a while. But they'll keep reacting to you.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Now, we've got plenty of time. Shall we get to the point?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: We don't have much time.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: All right. Ask or request whatever you want. I'll hear it and decide.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What exactly is Knossos?

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: A place people of the human empire needn't concern themselves with. Where Creed's memories sleep, you might say.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Memories sleep?

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Long ago, there was a war here. As the Silvaria Empire gained control of the continent, the beastmen apparently became an inconvenience.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: They invaded, claiming to protect their own country. People said the Beastman Empire of Creed would fall, but...

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Genesis? Generis? A mage with a name like that helped, and they survived.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Xerenis?)

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Imperial citizens don't know these things. History always belongs to the victors, and forgotten stories aren't interesting.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Knossos remembers everything: when the gods fled, and when the Silvaria Empire trampled it. Perhaps that's why...

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: It naturally rejects power it doesn't want. Strange, isn't it? The power you brought is what has made the place like this.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Now, who are you?

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: What do you want from Knossos?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (He thinks I'm from the empire. I don't need to tell him everything...)

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: You look troubled. A moment ago, you seemed eager to learn everything.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I need an object that's here.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Some relic lying around? There are plenty, so I wouldn't mind you taking one...

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Are you something like a Champion?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Enough power to disturb Knossos... You must be on the level of the Champions on that other continent. Or one of the church's Demigods...

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: You look far too irreverent to be a sacred Demigod. Yes, there's a smell about you. Haha.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: I really do have a good eye for people. Hehe.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, well...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (...I'll let him think that. But a smell?)

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: ...If you need something, go that way. I don't know what you're looking for, but try the Memory of the Heart.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The Memory of the Heart?

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: I don't want to get involved with the Silvaria Empire, so finish your business and go. I hope you find what you want quickly. Come back if you have questions.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: I'll be nearby. It's time to pull the weeds anyway. Oh, the Memory of the Heart is farther inside.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Talos. I'll go there.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Nothing to thank me for. I'm only doing my job as Knossos's caretaker. Its only one now...

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: You're a poor liar, adventurer of the goddess... I wonder whether you'll survive in there.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: That so-called grand duke personally woke the two who were sleeping...

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Ah, what a nuisance. That jingling sound... Has His Grace come for an outing?

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: An imperial knight comes and goes, a spirit with an accent comes and goes, a little mercenary comes and goes. Like a stage set up exactly as the grand duke wishes.
(At Talos's sarcastic words, black butterflies fly in and form a human shape.)

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: That coin's clinking is irritating.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: It has been a while, Talos. Or rather...

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Don't use that name. And don't bother with your irritating formalities.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Courtesy is natural for a being with intellect and thought.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Ridiculous. What do you want?

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: And what is your purpose?

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Hahahahaha! Amusing. Me? Someone asked a favor.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: You intend to play along with the joke even knowing that?

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Then answer me, Your Grace. Why have you come out again?

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: I do not know what will become of the first approaching night, but I have preparations of my own.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: What? I've tolerated enough...
(Talos scowls and grabs Barbatos by the collar.)

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Our paths are different, after all. Mine differs from yours, who killed one who served a god...
(Barbatos grins, and the black butterflies around him suddenly multiply. Startled, Talos steps back.)

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Damned butterflies... They remind me of a certain goddess's. Though those are even more unpleasant...
(The darkness carried by the butterflies envelops Barbatos, then disappears.)

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Fine, Grand Duke... Let's see who gets to laugh first.
(Deep in the damp-smelling forest, a large structure connected to machinery and cables stands in the distance.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What's that?
(An unidentified sound drifts from somewhere, grating on the ears.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: And that sound... This feeling...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It's familiar... I know it. The sound of machinery coming from somewhere...)
Jingle.
Jingle. Jingle.
(A clear ringing of bells follows.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is that a bell? As though it's attached to something...
Jingle. Jingle. Jingle.
(The bell seems to draw closer, then suddenly falls silent.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Was it my imagination?
No.
(Someone pokes %s's cheek from behind.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wh-what?!
What do you mean, sweetie? It's me. Pasiphae.
(The girl calling herself Pasiphae opens her arms for an embrace, then realizes something and steps back.)

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: Aww, you're not my sweetie. Some little octopus turned up instead.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Excuse me. I'm not an octopus...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Cat ears? Then she doesn't seem to be a beastman... One of the Kali people? No, something's different... She has a tail.)
Jingle.
(The bell around Pasiphae's neck jingles as she moves.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Oh, the bell was hers? But she appeared behind me without my sensing her at all. What...?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Who are you?

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: I'm Pasiphae. One of Knossos's great caretakers.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I was told there was only one caretaker...)

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: But who are you, human? Did Xerenis send you?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Xerenis? The Archmage Xerenis?

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: Yes, Xerenis. I thought my sweetie had come looking for me. Go see him later.

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: But how do I get out of here? Strange, isn't it? I can't leave a place I enter every day.

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: I think it's been like this since my sweetie gave me that...

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: How did you get in here? You'd need a caretaker's permission...
(Pasiphae's eyes change as she licks her hand. A dagger appears at her fingertips and flashes toward %s's throat.)

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: Ooh, you dodged my attack.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (That was close...)

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: That wasn't the end of it... Huh? What's this? Black butterflies...
(Black butterflies suddenly fly in and surround Pasiphae.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Those butterflies are Barbatos's...
(The butterflies turn into deep darkness, swallow Pasiphae, and scatter.)
Jingle.
Jingle. Jingle.
Jingle. Jingle. Jingle.
(Pasiphae's bell rings frantically, then grows quieter.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I should follow that sound...
Jingle.
(After wandering through the Memory of the Heart, the adventurer faintly hears Pasiphae's bell from one side.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: She's definitely nearby...
(A little farther on, traces of black butterflies shedding darkness appear. Barbatos and Pasiphae slowly come into view.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (They seem to be talking. I'll watch for a moment.)

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: Barbatos, was it? What a difficult name.

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: So, Grand Duke, you're saying the subordinates my sweetie sent betrayed us?

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: And handed our empire over to Silvaria...

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: Xerenis promised us a future for Freios together. A continent where beastmen and humans would live as one...

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: The great mage Xerenis was murdered and could not join you. And you, a great warrior, and the beastmen's great king were put to sleep by a subordinate.

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: X-Xerenis is dead?

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Regrettably.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Someone who does not believe in gods used divine power to stop time in Knossos. How interesting.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: For several hundred years, too... Something similar happened on another continent, around the same time...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Wait, I've heard something like this before...)

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Still, I, who will become a god, took the trouble to wake you. Though I could not free you from your respective areas.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Your subordinate was quite thorough. I tried waking you once before, but you were too deeply asleep.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Even as a prank, isn't it terribly cruel?

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: ...Can I trust you?

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: The butterfly ornament in your hair. Long ago, I gave it to the beastman king as a token of friendship.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: He said there was a woman he cherished.

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: Oh, my sweetie did? Then maybe I can trust you. Grand Duke, what should I do?

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Why not speak with the goddess's adventurer, who is eavesdropping over there?

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: As I told you before, %s, you have no choice.

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: Listen, Grand Duke...
(Pasiphae grins and draws two daggers. Moving at incredible speed, she appears behind Barbatos.)

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: A mere fiend dares order the beastmen's greatest warrior around? When you give up your throat so easily...
(Barbatos gently pushes the dagger away from his throat with a fingertip.)

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: How regrettable. To make me say it again... Miss Pasiphae, you truly are foolish. I came to help...

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: A beastman who trusted foolish gods and believed humans and beastmen could unite... Of course you would make such a choice.

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: U-ugh... My arms are m-moving on their own...

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: I could cut you down here, but you are no fitting opponent for me. That must be why you stand beside that foolish beastman king.

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: I'll kill you. But my body is moving on its own...

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Please fight someone suited to you. That adventurer of the goddess will do nicely.
(At Barbatos's words, Pasiphae slowly walks toward %s.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Barbatos. After what you did to Lady Michaela...

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: Mika? The one who fought alongside the gods long ago?

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: You saved even a battle angel from me, adventurer of the goddess. I hope you will save this ancient beastman warrior too.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: A witch preparing a new night, that foolish ruler of the Demon Realm, Lux, and the god of terror summoned by a sinner...

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: The old man has prepared a revolting number of things to destroy this world...

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Such nuisances...
(Barbatos's face twists as he adjusts his glasses, but he soon regains his composure.)

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Whew. How rude of me. I have much to do, so I shall leave. I've said far too much.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: And Miss Pasiphae, nothing I told you was a lie. That adventurer will prove my words, so fight to the death.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: I look forward to seeing the awakened beastman king. If he gives in to anger, Freios will surely...

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: He mustn't become angry...

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Now, Miss Pasiphae. Cut down the god you cherish, and the adventurer that god chose.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: A life as a godslayer, a Deicide, would not be so bad...
(At Barbatos's gesture, Pasiphae's eyes change.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's like what happened to Lady Michaela... I don't know if it'll work, but I have to try with my power.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Iris...)
(After a difficult battle, %s puts every last ounce of strength into a final strike that grazes Pasiphae.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (She was a difficult opponent. Please let that be the last attack. I can barely hold on...)

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: Thank you...
(Pasiphae's legs give way, and she sinks to the ground.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you all right?

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: I'm fine. You brought me back to normal... That fiend calling himself a grand duke made me use so much strength.
(Pasiphae puts away her weapons and stares at %s's face.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is it?

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: Nothing. I feel like I've seen you before... Oh, that's not it.

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: This ribbon... I only wore it because my sweetie gave it to me. But it carried that grand duke's power. It's gone now...

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: But it's strange. A fiend's power shouldn't be able to control me... What is that grand duke?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's a long story...

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: Then tell me the short version.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well...

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: You don't trust me, huh? Tell me, and I'll help as much as I can. You're the goddess's adventurer, right? You didn't come here for nothing.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right, then...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The adventurer briefly tells Pasiphae about the new goddess Iris, Barbatos's identity, and the reason for coming to Knossos.)

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: So Goddess Seres has a successor. I didn't even know how many gods remained... And that grand duke wants to become this world's god himself...

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: It's complicated, but I understand.

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: I've never seen the Twisted One Deimos, but I know how dangerous his arrival would be. Maybe not as dangerous as the Demon King, the Beast...

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: I once felt that terror approaching Freios.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's why I'm looking for a way to stop Deimos here.

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: Here? There's nothing like that here... Oh, could it be this?
(Pasiphae takes something out and shows it to %s.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A heart-shaped stone? It's broken.

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: The Heart of Rage. You could call it a token of our love. My sweetie has the other half.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Th-that startled me! What is this? It's beating like a real heart!

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: That's right. A heart. It's also the heart of the golems we treasure.

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: We made so many golems for the gods during the twilight. They should be here, charging from the heart... Huh?

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: Gone...? They're all gone! Our golems, sleeping in the Heart of Knossos... Gone!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Golems?

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: Yes, golems. If they're gone, Creed must have been completely betrayed... This won't do. I have to tell my sweetie quickly. Come with me. I'll help.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. Let's go together.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Pasiphae, what's wrong?

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: I can't leave... Some power spread through this place is stopping me. Is this that grand duke's doing too?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: Nothing for it. Go see my sweetie for me. If I'm stuck here, he must be unable to leave his place too.

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: I wonder what he's doing now...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Don't worry too much. I'll go and meet him.

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: Then I'll entrust the Heart of Rage to you.
(Pasiphae takes the heart-shaped stone from her clothes and places it in %s's hand.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (So this is the Heart of Rage... It vibrates powerfully. As though it's angry.)

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: The Heart of Rage is a part of this world entrusted to us by a god. An object from the twilight... My sweetie has the other half. Put them together, and it should help stop the Twisted One.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Pasiphae. Where should I go to meet him?

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: Acro's Coffin... You'll find it easily. You have to help me get out later too, all right?

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: Don't worry about me. This is my land, so I'll be fine. Your goddess, the new goddess, says it'll be all right too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris does?

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: Yes. So hurry along.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will... I'm sorry. I'll find a way and come back.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I should see Talos first.)

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: Such a tender-hearted child, just like Xerenis. Next time, I'll ask if we can be friends.

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: But the grand duke clearly said someone who didn't believe in gods used divine power to stop time in Knossos.

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: (...Talos. Daedalus. Which one of you did this?)

steps.name: An Observer, Not a Keeper
steps.objective: Turn in the quest to [Medea] in 「Kali」.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Finished your business?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No. I haven't found what I need yet. But Talos...

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A fiend appeared in there. Do you know anything about it?

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: A fiend? Why would one be in Knossos...? I know nothing...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Does he really not know, or is he pretending? Still, he isn't getting in my way, so I won't dwell on it.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Really? Hmm. Then I'll have to go to Acro's Coffin.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: But what did the fiend say?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: He wondered what the king would be like if he became angry...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Talos's expression changed for a moment.)

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: I don't know who this angry person is, but there's no one like that in this forgotten land. A mere caretaker like me has nothing to be angry about. But a fiend...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Anyway, I'll go to Acro's Coffin, as discussed.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: I'll be wandering around, so find me if anything happens.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Oh, Acro's Coffin will be a little more complicated than the Memory of the Heart.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm sure it'll be fine. I'll be going.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Let's head to Acro's Coffin first.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I feel like something's about to happen... Huh, Iris?)

lines.speaker: 이리스의 목소리
lines.text: (%s... Something is strange about Knossos. I'll send you somewhere safe for a moment.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh? Whoa...
(Watching %s from afar, Talos gives a faint laugh when the adventurer suddenly vanishes.)

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Interesting. Did a god call?

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: It has nothing to do with me for now. Shall I just wait and see...?

steps.name: Minos, King of the Beastfolk
steps.objective: Defeat [Minos] in 「Acro's Coffin」 and obtain the <Heart of Wrath: Right Fragment>. Then report to [Talos] in 「Knossos」.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: You startled me, appearing so suddenly.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I was surprised to see you in front of me too, Lady Medea. But what a relief. I didn't fall out of the sky this time!

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Ah, Lady Iris must still be learning. But you've brought something. May I see it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, yes...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The adventurer shows Medea the half of the Heart of Rage and recounts what happened in Knossos and the Memory of the Heart.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: The Heart of Rage... The mysterious object said to have exploded and driven enemies from Knossos during the war in Freios...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Even as a half, I can feel something. This anger...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: And as I expected, the caretakers Talos and Pasiphae you described differ little from the Kali people.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Moreover, receiving a message from the goddess means...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's complicated.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: There is much to unravel, but it isn't so complicated, %s...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: If the beastman king holds the other half, you will need me to make them whole.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Lady Iris...
(Medea looks up and calls Iris's name. A moment later, Iris slowly appears beside %s.)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Lady Medea...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I know it is difficult, but I would like you to send me to Knossos as well.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I'm all right. Then are you ready?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Whether to go to Knossos or to act for Eastland, I have made up my mind. I will go and find what I must do there.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Thank you, Lady Medea. Then I'll hurry. And %s...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, Iris. But what did you mean about Knossos's energy turning strange?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I'm not certain, but someone seems to dislike divine power drawing near. That's why I sent you here for now.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Knossos seems all right again. I'll let you return with Lady Medea.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Iris.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I'll make sure you land well this time. Don't worry.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait. Land well?
(By the time the adventurer notices Iris's apologetic expression, it is already far too late.)

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: I heard something land with a thud. So it was you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Owww...

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: And you there... You seem to be with this one. Are you a servant of a god?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Half right, half wrong.
(Talos stares at Medea.)

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Heh. You really are different from that person. Those clothes, that staff...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Please refrain from comparing me to someone you know.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Living beings can't help comparing others with what they know. Anyway, is this your first visit to Knossos?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: My first, but I do not wish to stay long.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: ...Do you reject this place?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Sigh... I understand you dislike gods. That must be why you are involved with that person.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Our aims simply align. Nothing more.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: You said the same when that person acted before. But you know very well what came of it.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Enough. Finish your business and leave. Otherwise...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Thank you. I will exchange no further words with you after this.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Extraordinary, as expected.
(Medea rests her staff against %s's shoulder while the adventurer is still dazed.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: It seems the goddess still struggles to control long-distance travel. Are you all right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. I feel better, thanks to you... But you seemed to be speaking with Talos...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I will explain after we meet the beastman king. Come.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. But... Lady Medea.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, never mind. Let's go first.
(Talos stares after Medea and %s as they head toward Acro's Coffin.)

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: No wonder that woman called her someone she could rely on. But she'll take a different path. Now that I've confirmed it, shall I play a little prank of my own...?
(Talos raises his staff and points at the sun.)

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: The beastman king is rather pitiful. Waking after such a long sleep...
(As the tip of the staff taps the ground, a strange energy flows out, drawing forth a resonance never before felt in Knossos.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: The sky weeps, and the earth rages... Ah, %s, watch your step.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The ground shaking so suddenly startled me.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Someone unhappy about our arrival probably caused it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Did you say... our?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Yes. Our. Is there a problem?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No... I was just surprised.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Pay no mind to such small things. Focus on meeting the beastman king in Acro's Coffin.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Of course.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Still, this place seems to have more buried beneath it than I expected...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: We must learn what the liar is hiding, though he will not tell us easily...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The liar...? Huh?
No... No! This cannot be! Aaaaaagh!
Grrrr... Why has this land that I, Minos, protected become like this...?
(A voice cries out in rage, and the ground that had stilled begins shaking again.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Minos?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: That seems to be the beastman king's voice. Minos must be his name.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Whatever the case, he has realized something and cannot contain his anger... The energy within the land seems to be feeding it...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: We do not know what has caused his suffering, but this meeting will certainly be difficult.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...We may have to fight.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Yes...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: But you needn't worry too much.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: %s, you said you wandered through the Memory of the Heart, correct?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: This place seems much the same. Some mechanisms have been put in place... I'll undo what I can...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: %s, go ahead first. Then at least you won't spend too long lost.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Meet the beastman king and keep him talking for as long as you can. I'll follow soon.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: We must stop him quickly... If his power uses the Heart of Rage, the consequences will not end with Knossos...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll hurry. Please be careful.
(%s departs, and the beastman king's rage soon rings out again.)

lines.speaker: 미노스의 목소리
lines.text: Aaaaaagh! Now that you have entered this place, you will never leave alive...
(The beastman king's furious cries fill Knossos.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I can feel pain... This is...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I'll keep your anger from growing. Please hold on a little longer...
(As the adventurer heads toward the center of Acro's Coffin, the beings in the way fall or retreat.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Whew, I finally made it this far... Good thing I didn't get too lost. Is it all thanks to Lady Medea?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Now I only need to get over this hill...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh? The rumbling stopped?
(Minos's cries, which shook all of Knossos moments ago, can no longer be heard.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Something's wrong... Why did it stop so suddenly?

lines.speaker: 미노스의 목소리
lines.text: Why do you have a fragment of the heart?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh?!
(The owner of the voice that filled Knossos suddenly appears as though rising from the ground. Startled, the adventurer falls.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You startled me...

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: To be frightened at the sight of me is most displeasing. I shall show mercy. Take this and rise.
(Minos extends his staff toward %s on the ground.)

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: I am Minos, sovereign of Creed. And this is my castle, Acropolis...

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: I will not say it again. Rise.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I'd better take it and get up...)

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: Now, tell me. Who are you, and why do you have the fragment Pasiphae held?

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: And why have you come here...? I wish to know everything.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Maybe we can talk after all.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Right. I'm %s...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The adventurer briefly introduces themself and explains the reason for coming, along with what happened to Pasiphae.)

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: I see. I understand somewhat.

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: So you need the Heart of Rage?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. With that relic, we can stand against the villain trying to summon Deimos.

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: Is that so?
(Minos quietly takes out a stone fragment that appears to be the Heart of Rage.)

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: You do not understand what this heart means.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lord Minos?

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: Did you think I would simply give it to you?
(Minos puts the fragment away and swings his staff. Power explodes around them, hurling the adventurer far back.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh... Why...?

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: I cannot trust you.

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: I do not yet know whether your words are truth or lies.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Trust... He's saying the same thing as Lady Medea.)

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: If you want my trust, face my trial and prove yourself. Prove that you serve the new god.

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: It will not be easy to defeat me...
(Minos raises his staff again and looks at %s.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (No choice, then. This won't be easy... Iris, protect me...)
(Attacks powerful enough to shake Knossos follow without pause.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (This will never end. I have to finish it in one blow.)

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: Let us stop for a moment.
(As though reading %s's expression, Minos lowers his staff. Then he throws something to %s.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This is...?

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: I will give it to you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The Heart of Rage... Do you trust me?

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: I saw faith within your attacks. I cannot call it the trust I seek... But I would like you to face me a little longer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: You are an excellent opponent for my rage. Come at me with all your strength...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You mean keep fighting? If we do, Knossos will be in danger... There's something dangerous about your power...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: %s is correct.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lady Medea...

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: You... Is your name Medea?
(Medea nods at Minos's question. He watches with interest as she steps before him.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Yes. You must know that your anger cannot be allowed to continue and meet the memories held within the heart...

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: ...I know.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Then you must put aside your anger.

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: And if I will not?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: If you wish yourself and the Knossos you love to vanish from the map of Freios, then continue.
(Minos looks incredulous at Medea's words, then begins laughing wildly.)

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: Hahaha... Hahahahaha...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Beastman King, thank you. I will find a way for both of you to leave this place.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Then... neither Pasiphae nor Minos can get out?)

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: I may trust you?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Yes. I promise. If you cannot trust me, then my power...

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: I do not need your power. Promise me one thing instead. That human.
(Minos points at the adventurer.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Me?

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: Have that human visit me often. Then I will do what I can, whether for this world, for you, or for a god.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Thank you, Lord Minos. And %s... Come closer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right.
(Medea shows %s the Heart of Rage fragments in her hands. Then she clenches her fists, shattering them.)

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: Together with Knossos's memories...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lady Medea? Why would you break the Heart of Rage...? This is...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: A trace of my power...
(Medea forms a sphere of power mingled with the Heart of Rage at her fingertips, then places it in %s's hand.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lady Medea...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Hold it to your chest.
(As %s's hand touches the adventurer's chest, the sphere sinks inside.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is this feeling...? At last, the power of every Champion...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Now Lady Iris will be able to see everything in Eastland. And perhaps recall some of Freios's memories as well.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Then that means...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Deimos will also be affected by Lady Iris and appear a little later. Ask her about the rest.
(Medea smiles and nudges %s forward.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Now go to Talos, who calls himself Knossos's caretaker. I have something to discuss with the beastman king...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lady Medea, let's go together.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: It will take some time. Go ahead.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. Then Lord Minos, I'll visit again.

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: Thank you...

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: You call yourself Medea, but your name was Medeia. The child Daphne chose...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I am neither Medeia nor that woman's child. Only the one who leads the Kali people.

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: So the village on the other continent is called Kali.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Together with Lady Iris, I will one day help you and Lady Pasiphae leave this place.

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: Even if you do not, someone else will come eventually. I will wait until then.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I do not know who may come, but I will do what I can.

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: Still, you must have known that choosing to serve a god could poison you. Now that the trace of your power has gone to a god, you...
(Medea smiles as though nothing is wrong.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I am all right. I merely showed the goddess the depth of my trust.

steps.name: Crossroads of Chaos
steps.objective: Turn in the quest to [Medea] in 「Kali」.

lines.text: (Talos's face twists when he sees %s.)

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: By the look of you, you've achieved what you came to Knossos for...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: She told me to come see you.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: I have nothing to say. Leave. Wait, you...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What's wrong?

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Something about you feels different...

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: The anger hanging over Knossos is gone. Tell me what happened.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, well...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The adventurer tells Talos what happened in Acro's Coffin.)

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Ahahaha... Hahahahaha... Hahahahaha!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why are you laughing like that?

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Nothing. This situation is just so funny...

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: I went to all the trouble of putting Knossos to sleep, and that damned grand duke came and woke it up.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: I disliked you prying into Knossos's secrets, so I provoked the beastman king. Yet you managed to survive.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Whew. I thought nothing would happen as long as I controlled Knossos, but apparently I was wrong... Ahahaha!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Talos, were you one of Lord Minos's people?

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: In the past.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: I know you're interested in me, but why don't we stop for today?

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Thanks to you, I have plenty to do. The Silvaria Empire and the Demon Realm have noticed things...

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: You'll find out whether you want to or not. So stay alive.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Only the dead post commander ended up unfortunate.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why did the post commander die?

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: You want to learn more from me? You really are interested in me.
(Talos grins.)

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: I'll tell you that. Commander Disel discovered a secret hidden here. He came looking for me to confirm it...

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: But before that, he met someone else and died... He was a good friend. More precisely, that being came to him...

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: I buried the commander in a sunny spot. His grave is over there somewhere, so don't worry. That's all I know. I don't know who the being was either. Find out for yourself...

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Oh, if you want to learn more from me, visit now and then. You'll have to build trust.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Trust...)

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Quite a few people here need someone to talk to. How you build that trust is your choice. Hehe...
(With the conversation largely finished, Talos turns away and disappears along a path in Knossos.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Talos?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...He's gone.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What happened in this place? I achieved what I came for, but something still feels wrong...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Where should I go now...? Huh?)
(Someone gently taps %s on the shoulder.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, Lady Medea? You're back?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: You must have finished speaking with Talos. Then let us return to Kali.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Straight from here to Kali?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Any stone holding Knossos's memories will send us there. To the village of our Kali people...
(Medea picks up a stone engraved with a pattern and rests it in her hand. The stone holding Knossos's memories scatters like dust and carries them away.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I wondered whether it would work. We really made it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Lady Medea? That means we might not have reached Kali.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Hehe. Don't be so frightened.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Did your conversation with the beastman king go well?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Speaking with Lord Minos gave me a curious sense of faith in Knossos.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Who is Talos, really?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Now I can tell you. Had we discussed him there, we might not have been able to leave either...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What? What do you mean...?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Knossos as it is now could be called that man himself... In any case...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: He killed someone who followed a god. And he wants beings like himself to stand above the humans the gods love.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Long ago, that woman told me...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: There was an older brother who killed his god-following younger brother, made himself caretaker of a land, and swallowed that land...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: The older brother's name was Daedalus... The one now called Talos...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I do not know what he is planning, but he seems to have made a bargain with her.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Perhaps that bargain is what brought certain people from Knossos to Kali...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I don't know for certain. But... This is my concern, %s, something you need not know. Continue to focus on what stands in Lady Iris's way.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will, Lady Medea.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: And I believe we will need to go to Debora soon.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Soon...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Lady Iris will probably tell you when the time comes. %s, even after Avalon, your work will not be finished.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There are still many enemies.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I will help, so please visit often.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Lady Medea.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Not at all. Rest in Kali today. I'll speak to Beinan... Have a meal, too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will. Thank you, Lady Medea.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Go to Merimel. She will show you somewhere to rest.
(As %s heads toward Merimel, Medea, left alone, quietly looks up at the sky.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: My choice was not wrong. I do not regret it. And I will stop that person's games.
